reviews.critique: The input is a coherent dictated report with recoverable intent and no leaked authoring instructions or material contradictions. Across all eight paragraphs, the output preserves the wording, facts, quantities, names, labels, quotations, conditional thresholds, and unresolved review status. Changes are limited to capitalization, punctuation, and rendering the spoken quotation and numbered-list cues, as permitted by /transcribe. The resulting language and formatting are natural and appropriate.
